RECIPE:
Steak:
▪9-10 oz filet mignon
▪coarse salt
▪black pepper
▪neutral oil (canola, avocado, etc)

Diane Sauce:
▪85g (about 4-5) cremini/baby bellas, med diced
▪60g (1 large) shallot, finely diced
▪8g (2 cloves) garlic, minced
▪125g (1/2 cup) cognac 
▪175g (3/4 cup) beef stock
▪15g (1 Tbsp) Dijon 
▪10g (2 tsp) Worcestershire sauce
▪60g (1/4 cup) heavy cream
30g (2 Tbsp) unsalted butter
1g (about 1 tsp) fresh thyme, minced (3 sprigs)
2g (about 1 Tbsp) fresh parsley, minced
neutral oil

1. Slice the filet crosswise into 2 medallions. Pound to even 3/4-inch thickness and season with salt and pepper. rest on plate.
